why_test_now: Softgood pack volume, seam integrity, inflation behavior and extraction cannot be established by dry CAD.
design_question: Can an exact 60 L catalog bag survive the DF8 fold/deploy/inflate/load cycle and accept a safe controlled inflation/relief interface?
required_adapters_fixtures: Non-cutting pack canister surrogate; instrumented inlet adapter; vendor-approved low-differential relief; representative tether/load fixture
underwater_test_concept: Dry baseline inspection; submerged pack/eject/inflate at owner-approved ambient-pressure cases; hold at full volume; controlled ascent/vent behavior; post-test seam and valve inspection.
instrumentation: Calibrated absolute and differential pressure; water/air temperature; flow or source mass; synchronized video; load cell; volume measurement; stopwatch
data_to_record: Packed volume; extraction force/time; inflation pressure/time; gas mass; achieved volume; leakage/volume loss; seam strain/damage; tether load; reset time
provisional_pass_fail: At vendor-approved differential pressure: both specimens deploy without snag/rupture; reach at least 90% of nominal 60 L within the approved time; lose no more than 5% volume in 30 min; no permanent seam/valve/tether damage. Criteria remain provisional until vendor limits and mission depth are approved.
pressure_rated_fixture_chamber_required: YES - a rated water-pressure chamber or controlled open-water fixture is required for depth simulation; no unprotected pressure test
procurement_gate: Manufacturer page reports sold out; locate authorized dealer stock and obtain written configuration/lot/return/certificate statement before purchase.

why_test_now: This is the preferred COTS pressure-boundary lead, but radial fit, external-pressure resistance, valve/relief integration and receiving traceability are not demonstrated.
design_question: Can the exact DOT-3A cylinder be packaged and operated as a service-exchange booster without external-pressure damage or unsafe pressure architecture?
required_adapters_fixtures: Official CAD fit gauge; certified cylinder valves; correct gas-specific relief; regulator; rated cradle; remote protected pressure panel; hydrostatic chamber
underwater_test_concept: Receive and document both empty cylinders; dimensional/marking inspection; external hydrostatic exposure in a qualified chamber at owner-approved mission pressure; qualified integrator leak/regulated-discharge trial within manufacturer limits; post-test inspection.
instrumentation: Calibrated internal/external pressure; temperature; strain or diameter gauge; mass scale; flow meter; leak detector; synchronized video
data_to_record: Serial/marking/cert documents; OD/length/mass; external pressure/time; strain/permanent set; leak rate; regulator pressure/flow; temperature; usable gas; residual pressure
provisional_pass_fail: Both serialized articles match the PO and documents; no leakage or visible damage; permanent OD change no greater than 0.2% after owner-approved external-pressure exposure; regulated discharge stays inside approved pressure/temperature envelope and supplies the approved gas budget. Final pressure criterion requires manufacturer/integrator approval.
pressure_rated_fixture_chamber_required: YES - qualified rated hydrostatic chamber and protected/remote pressure fixture; no improvised vessel and no uncontrolled pneumatic proof
procurement_gate: REQUEST QUOTE ONLY. Buy empty cylinders only after written CoC/MTR/serial/hydro/relief options and official drawing are reviewed. Filling is a separate approval.

why_test_now: The baseline damper is sealed but uses black-anodized aluminum, hard-chrome steel and zinc-plated end fittings; ACE publishes no underwater or external-pressure rating.
design_question: Does external water pressure, saltwater exposure or contamination change damping, breakaway, leakage, corrosion or reset behavior enough to invalidate the baseline selection?
required_adapters_fixtures: Rated submerged linear-actuation fixture; positive stops 1-1.5 mm before end of stroke; representative clevis pins; guard
underwater_test_concept: Measure dry force-speed baseline; cycle submerged at owner-approved pressure/temperature; dwell; repeat force-speed test; saltwater exposure and post-rinse inspection; compare specimen-to-specimen drift.
instrumentation: Calibrated load cell; displacement encoder; speed control; external pressure; water/oil temperature; cycle counter; leakage mass/visual inspection; video
data_to_record: Breakaway force; compression/extension force versus speed; stroke; free travel; pressure/temperature; cycles; leakage; corrosion; adjustment drift; reset time
provisional_pass_fail: Both specimens complete the approved cycle/dwell without oil leak or binding; force at each controlled speed remains within +/-20% of its pre-wet baseline; no corrosion that impairs function; positive stops remain effective. Criterion is provisional pending system-level damping requirement.
pressure_rated_fixture_chamber_required: YES for mission-depth simulation; otherwise an instrumented submerged fixture is required
procurement_gate: Obtain exact suffix confirmation, current drawing, new-production date, certificate/lot statement, and two matched specimens.
